item.title: Eri
item.description:
Fourteen at the story’s start. A defiant punk – outwardly confident, practical, observant, dry. Secretly the princess of Kraeta.

She refuses to stay blind.

Beyond

Daughter of King Lachesis and Queen Hren. Her father set an anchor on her forehead at age four; it is what unlocks the blink.

item.title: Malachar
item.description: A dragon. She let herself be killed so that Issah would become the Dragon Slayer and turn the prophecy.

item.title: Urmez
item.description: Issah’s little brother. He starved to death in Issah’s arms – Urmez around six, Issah around twelve.
